events.label: Betrawati's 09:30 reports are missing (stations destroyed). This closes the front-arrival bracket at Betrawati (09:20 to 09:30)
events.quote: Trishuli at Betrawati, station 52. Series ends with a normal 3.55 m at 09:20, matching the situation report's telemetry-loss time, and the 09:30 report never came

note: Arrival at a gauge is the DHM ten-minute bracket: after its last normal reading, by its first rise or silence; the replay runs the front through the bracket midpoints along the D8 flow path on the Copernicus DEM. Places between gauges are interpolated by distance along that path; beyond Betrawati the front is extrapolated at the last gauged speed.
